data.title: Hop Back on the Number Line
data.description: Practice backward jumps and ordering numbers on a number line up to 10.

challenges.instruction: Let's put our numbers in order! Can you arrange 8, 5, and 7 from smallest to largest?
challenges.hint: Find each number on the line first and look at which one comes first as you count up.

challenges.instruction: Look at the numbers 3, 6, and 4 on the number line. Can you drag or place them in order from the smallest number to the largest number?
challenges.hint: Find each number on the line first to see which one comes first!

challenges.instruction: Let us put our numbers in order! Look at the numbers 8, 4, and 5 on your number line, and arrange them from the smallest to the largest.
challenges.hint: Find each number on the line first to see which one comes first!

challenges.instruction: Look at the numbers 7, 5, and 4. Can you put them in order from smallest to largest on the number line?
challenges.hint: Find each number on the line first to see which one comes first!
